{{Current events|year=2019|month=01|day=22|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**A [[Hamas]] militant is killed and  two others are injured when an [[Israel]]i tank fires into the [[Gaza Strip]] after a protest turned violent. The [[Israel Defense Forces]] action is retaliation for a shooting which lightly injured an officer, and for the brief incursion of two Palestinians into Israel. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-palestinians-violence/israel-kills-hamas-militant-delays-qatari-cash-after-gaza-flare-up-idUSKCN1PG23J?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Timeline of the 2019 Venezuelan protests|2019 Venezuelan protests]]
**A 16-year-old boy is shot and killed at around midnight on Tuesday evening/Wednesday morning during protests in the Venezuelan capital [[Caracas]]. Three others are killed in overnight protests in [[Bolívar (state)|Estado Bolívar]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/the_americas/opposition-launches-protests-to-oust-maduro-as-us-venezuela-tensions-rise/2019/01/22/0416687a-1e4f-11e9-a759-2b8541bbbe20_story.html?utm_term=.27e272661928 (''The Washington Post'')], [https://www.business-standard.com/article/pti-stories/four-dead-in-clashes-ahead-of-venezuela-protests-police-ngo-119012301241_1.html (Business Standard)]

;Arts and culture
*The nominees for the [[91st Academy Awards]], honoring the best in [[2018 in film|cinema in 2018]] are announced, with ''[[Roma (2018 film)|Roma]]'' and ''[[The Favourite]]'' leading with 10 nominations each. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/01/22/movies/oscar-nominations-academy-awards.html (''The New York Times'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 Piper PA-46 Malibu disappearance]]
**In the [[Channel Islands]], a multinational search and rescue operation for a missing aircraft carrying [[Cardiff City F.C.]] footballer [[Emiliano Sala]] resumes, after fading light and deteriorating weather conditions caused the search to be called off the previous day. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-guernsey-46954922 (BBC)]
*Five foreign [[demining]] experts, identified as two [[South Africa]]ns, one [[Croatia]]n, one [[Bosnia]]n and one [[Kosovo|Kosovar]], are killed in an accidental explosion in [[Yemen]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-46958455 (BBC)]
*A [[Tupolev]] [[Tu-22M3]] supersonic strike bomber crashes in Russia's northwestern [[Murmansk Oblast|Murmansk]] region while attempting landing during a storm. Three of its four crewmen are killed. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-military-airplane-crash/nuclear-capable-russian-bomber-crashes-amid-snowstorm-defence-ministry-idUSKCN1PG23L (Reuters)]

;International relations
*[[Kuril Islands dispute]], [[Japan–Russia relations]]
**Japanese Prime Minister [[Shinzō Abe]] and Russian President [[Vladimir Putin]] meet in Moscow to discuss a peace treaty and the [[Kuril Islands]] dispute. [http://tass.com/world/1041157 (TASS)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/01/putin-hosting-abe-talks-break-70-year-island-deadlock-190122011154875.html (Al Jazeera)]
*An Israeli spokesman says Israeli Prime Minister [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] has cancelled Wednesday's [[Qatar|Qatari]] aid of $15 million to [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-palestinians-violence/israel-kills-hamas-militant-delays-qatari-cash-after-gaza-flare-up-idUSKCN1PG23J?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Law and crime	
*American singer [[Chris Brown]] and two associates are briefly detained in [[Paris]] after being accused of aggravated rape and drug offenses. [https://www.nbcnews.com/pop-culture/celebrity/singer-chris-brown-detained-paris-after-rape-accusation-n961141 (NBC News)]
*[[Transgender personnel in the United States military]]
**The [[U.S. Supreme Court]] allows, by a 5–4 vote, the Trump administration to begin implementing the policy that prohibits [[transgender]] persons who require or have undergone gender transition from serving. Unresolved challenges remain in lower courts. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-46963426 (BBC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2018 North Carolina's 9th congressional district election]]
**[[North Carolina Superior Court]] judge Paul Ridgeway rejects the bid to certify Republican [[Mark Harris (North Carolina politician)|Mark Harris]] as the winner of the country's last undecided congressional race until there's a final decision in the investigation into possible illegal tactics. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-election-north-carolina/judge-rejects-republicans-bid-to-be-certified-winner-of-north-carolina-election-idUSKCN1PG2CQ?il=0 (Reuters)] [https://www.wsoctv.com/news/local/judge-to-hear-arguments-in-district-9-election-investigation/907214378 (WSOC-TV)]

;Sports
* [[2019 Baseball Hall of Fame balloting]]
** The [[National Baseball Hall of Fame and Museum|National Baseball Hall of Fame]] announces the results of voting by the [[Baseball Writers' Association of America]] (BBWAA) to determine players to be formally inducted in July 2019. [[Roy Halladay]], [[Edgar Martínez]], [[Mike Mussina]], and [[Mariano Rivera]] are elected and will join [[Harold Baines]] and [[Lee Smith (baseball)|Lee Smith]], elected by [[Veterans Committee|a Hall committee]] in December 2018, at the induction ceremonies in [[Cooperstown, New York]]. Rivera is the first player ever to be elected unanimously by the BBWAA. [http://www.espn.com/mlb/story/_/id/25826814/mariano-rivera-edgar-martinez-roy-halladay-mike-mussina-elected-baseball-hall-fame (ESPN)]
